description: viber hooks: injects the viber manifest at session start, and gates ExitPlanMode on a review of the plan. The SessionStart hook writes hooks/content/manifest.md verbatim into the main session's context once per session (source == "resume" excluded, since the prior injection reloads with the transcript) and falls back to the version banner alone when that file is empty or unreadable. The banner gains a schema note when the project's .claude/viber.yml schema lags the plugin template's (run /viber:setup) or is ahead of it (update the plugin), and stays plain when the numbers match or no file exists. The plan gate is armed only when the current plan-mode episode shows a Write/Edit of a plans/*.md file; the reviewer is viber:planner-review when the planner skill ran in the episode (a Skill tool_use, plugin prefix included) and the plan file opens with the planner frontmatter source: line (an unreadable plan keeps planner-review), otherwise viber:plain-plan-review, and only when .claude/viber.yml turns planning.plain-plan-review on. Anything else - planning.plain-plan-review off, an exit in a session that already built a plan - passes untouched. When armed it allows ExitPlanMode only after a dispatch of that reviewer that followed the last plan write returned 'VERDICT: PASS', with the plan file untouched since that verdict (mtime vs. the transcript timestamp). A planner plan past 12 task blocks (lines that are <!-- TASK --> alone) is gated on the whole review set instead: viber:planner-spec-review, viber:planner-graph-review and viber:planner-task-review dispatches whose tasks: T<a>-T<b> prompt lines cover every task (slices of at most 8) must each have returned 'VERDICT: PASS' after the last plan write, a missing member, a FAIL, a DENIED and a plan touched after the earliest deciding verdict each denying with its own next step; a plan of 12 tasks or fewer, or one the gate cannot read, stays on planner-review alone. The UserPromptSubmit hook adds plan-writing hints (a closing subagent review task, parallel subagents for independent tasks) to every prompt sent in plain plan mode, silent once the planner, intent or fixer skill ran in the episode. The PreToolUse hook on Bash (kill-guard.sh) refuses, inside a viber agent (agent_type starting with viber:), a command that stops processes by name - killall, pkill, taskkill with /IM, xargs running kill, kill fed by a command substitution - and tells the agent to stop only the PIDs it started with kill <PID>; it is silent for the main session, other agents and every other command, and never answers allow. The second PreToolUse hook on Bash (shell-guard.sh) refuses, inside viber:task-coder, a chained command (an unquoted ;, && or ||), git stash, checkout, restore or clean, rm, and a file write through Bash (sed -i, perl -pi, a redirect or tee onto a relative path outside .temp/), and inside viber:task-reviewer and viber:final-reviewer the four git subcommands only; the guard is silent for every other caller. Both guards open every refusal with "viber guard:" and name the fix. The SubagentStop hook (verdict-nudge.sh) blocks the stop of a viber agent other than the scout, mapper and hunter once, with a nudge to return its output lines, when its final message holds no VERDICT: or AUDIT: line; it is silent when stop_hook_active is true, for any other agent and for unreadable input. Every hook fails open: any parse miss or unreadable input allows. The hooks module register.tsx answers one Write refusal: when the harness guard rejects a viber agent's Write of a .md file whose name starts with report, summary, findings or analysis (a host's own domain name, such as reports.pl.md), for a path inside the project root, it writes that file itself and returns the Write result; every other Write passes through unchanged.
